subject: Availability deviation proposal, evidence mapping, and order-form language
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medisphere.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medisphere.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: availability deviation & evidence for order form (MSA attached)

Karthik --

Thanks for taking this. We're in the procurement loop for our enterprise agreement with Redwood and have two asks before we can move to signature: a tailored availability rider (we need a controlled deviation from the standard 99.9% uptime to 99.5% for a defined set of endpoints) and a clear evidence package your team can provide for uptime/latency diagnostics.

High-level background: Medisphere will be using Redwood for a latency-sensitive clinical inference pipeline (primarily inference calls for decision support). We anticipate a steady baseline of 75 requests/sec with spikes up to ~400 RPS during batch ingestion windows. We need the order form to reflect the deviation and the MSA SOW exhibits to reference the evidence required for claims and credits.

Can you: 
- Confirm whether Redwood will accept a 99.5% availability commitment for the named endpoints (we'll provide endpoint list in a follow-up)
- Share a short list of evidence artifacts you can provide (uptime logs, monthly p95/p99 latency reports, regional failover audit)
- Advise estimated turnaround for a signed addendum (we're hoping to close within 3 weeks)

I've attached our MSA redlines and a one-pager usage profile. If helpful, loop in legal and ops.

Attachments: Medisphere_SLA_Request.pdf (pdf), MSA_Redlines_Medisphere_20261010.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Elena
Director, Procurement
Medisphere Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medisphere.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: availability deviation & evidence for order form (MSA attached)

Elena —

Appreciate the context and the attached redlines. Short answers up front: we can discuss a scoped availability rider at 99.5% for a limited set of endpoints (restricted by path/route and region) and we can provide a defined evidence package. We will need a bit more detail on which endpoints and the exact time windows for the high-volume batch windows to finalize the credit schedule.

Next steps I propose:
- Grace (CC'd) to confirm the evidence artifacts we can deliver and a sample report format.
- Stephanie (CC'd) to review the MSA redlines and the proposed language in the order form / exhibit.
- I will draft an availability rider that:
  * scopes the deviation to named endpoints and a single primary region;
  * defines uptime measurement methodology (per-calendar-month, rolling 30d),
  * includes a graduated credit schedule tied to monthly availability bands; and
  * includes agreed maintenance windows and notification obligations.

Question for you now: do you require support for a private deployment (VPC/on‑prem) as part of the order form? That impacts the evidence set and SLAs.

I've attached an initial draft availability rider (redwood_availability_rider_draft_v1.docx) — it's intentionally conservative. If you can send the endpoint list and the expected traffic window (timezone and hours), I'll produce a marked-up version within 5 business days.

Timeline: if we get endpoints + hours by EOD Wed (Oct 14), we'll aim to provide a legal-ready addendum and evidence checklist within 5 business days after that. DocuSign-ready within ~10 business days assuming limited redlines.

Thanks — I'll let Grace and Stephanie chime in on evidence / legal items.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medisphere.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bowers <tbowers@medisphere.com>, procurement@medisphere.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: availability deviation & evidence for order form (MSA attached)

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick reply and the draft. Confirming a few things:
- Endpoints: /api/v1/decision/* and /api/v1/embedding/* are the primary routes; we can provide a definitive list by EOD Wed (Oct 14).
- Batch windows: daily from 01:00 — 03:00 UTC and a weekly overnight window Saturday 23:00 — 02:00 UTC.
- Private deployment: not required at contract signing; we'll start with Redwood hosted in the US primary region and evaluate private later.
- Maintenance: we need a 48-hour advance notification for planned maintenance that could degrade availability.

On evidence: the procurement team would like to see the following as a minimum:
1) Monthly availability report (per-endpoint) with uptime % and outage windows
2) p95 and p99 latency reports (daily granularity for first 90 days)
3) Post-incident RCA and timeline for any creditable events
4) Audit logs showing regional failover exercises or automatic fallback activations

I've attached our MSA redlines again for visibility (MSA_Redlines_Medisphere_20261010.pdf). If you can confirm the evidence items above are deliverable or provide alternates, we'll proceed.

Elena

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medisphere.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: availability deviation & evidence for order form (MSA attached)

Folks — forwarding Medisphere's asks. Key asks summarized below (from Elena):
- Scoped availability rider for endpoints /api/v1/decision/* and /api/v1/embedding/* at 99.5%
- Evidence: monthly per-endpoint availability, daily p95/p99 for 90 days, RCA for incidents, audit logs for failover
- Maintenance notice: 48h preferred

Stephanie: can you review the attached MSA redlines and the draft rider I sent and flag any absolute no-go items? We should be ready to return a legal-ready addendum.

Grace: can we commit to the evidence package Elena lists? If not fully, please outline what we can deliver within 5 business days and what requires ops playbook changes. Also advise if the proposed credit schedule in my draft is reasonable given their traffic profile.

Target: produce a redline-ready addendum + evidence checklist by end of next week (Oct 20) so procurement can review and, if ok, route to DocuSign (Elena indicated a 3-week close target).

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, Oct 13, 2026 at 8:21 AM Elena Soto <elena.soto@medisphere.com> wrote:
> > Karthik —
> >
> > Thanks for the quick reply and the draft. Confirming a few things:
> > - Endpoints: /api/v1/decision/* and /api/v1/embedding/* are the primary routes; we can provide a definitive list by EOD Wed (Oct 14).
> > - Batch windows: daily from 01:00 — 03:00 UTC and a weekly overnight window Saturday 23:00 — 02:00 UTC.
> > - Private deployment: not required at contract signing; we'll start with Redwood hosted in the US primary region and evaluate private later.
> > - Maintenance: we need a 48-hour advance notification for planned maintenance that could degrade availability.

I'll coordinate with both of you and loop Legal if anything looks like it needs further escalation.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
